exceptionReason.description: Required in spirit for handoff_only / limitation / prohibited rows: the concrete OS, physical, or security reason. Reviewed explicitly; cannot be a placeholder for a shipped feature (issue #114 §3.1.3).

fields.description: Field-level inventory (M0): every field of every covered record type and object definition kind appears exactly once across the registry, on its owning capability. access: editable = user/AI may set it through typed tools; identity = set at creation, immutable (includes kind discriminators); system = server/native-assigned (timestamps, revision numbers, detected mime type, derived pointers); association = references another record; content = carried opaquely and edited only through typed operations, never as a raw field (snapshots, JSON context, archive/history mirrors); not_exposed = belongs to a prohibited capability and must never surface through MCP.

source.description: A projection record type (e.g. cooks) or definition kind (e.g. checklist).

fixtures.description: Fixture ids proving behavior (round-trip, conflict, negative). Presence of a tool name is not a fixture.

recordTypes.description: Projection record types touched, from contracts/private-sync-projection-v1.json (21 types at main fc422ca), or a companion definition kind.

scopes.description: Scope families from issue #114 §5. No public-write, billing, credential-management, admin, or hardware-control scope exists by design — adding one to this enum is itself a reviewed breaking change.

definitions.description: Companion/document definition kinds from contracts/private-sync-projection-v1.json covered by this capability.

_note.description: Coverage is per-operation-kind on purpose (issue #114 §3.1): a read-only mapping does not satisfy a writable private feature.

handler.description: Registered PrivateLibraryService handler symbol. Required when status=implemented.

tools.description: Tool names from issue #114 §3, e.g. create_meal. Empty when status is prohibited/not_applicable, with the reason carried in notes.

symbols.description: Real source symbols, e.g. com.pittech.data.CookRepository.createCook or CookStore.createMeal. CI checks these exist; a binding with no symbol is a stub, not coverage.

generatedViews.description: Files generated from this registry; CI fails if they are stale. Draft list: docs/MCP_PARITY.md, MCP tool input/output schemas, MCP tool descriptors.

deferredDefinitions.description: Projection definition kinds with no capability surface, each with a concrete reason. The parity check fails if a projection kind is neither covered nor deferred here.
